mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_risk) AS total_risks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_risk WHERE inherent_risk IN ('심각','높음')) AS high_risks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_control) AS total_controls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_control WHERE effectiveness = '효과적') AS effective_controls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_finding WHERE status IN ('미결','조치중')) AS open_findings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_finding WHERE status IN ('미결','조치중') AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_findings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_eval_plan WHERE eval_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS current_year_evals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itgc_eval_plan WHERE eval_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND status = '완료') AS completed_evals
SELECT inherent_risk AS level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM itgc_risk GROUP BY inherent_risk ORDER BY CASE inherent_risk WHEN '심각' THEN 1 WHEN '높음' THEN 2 WHEN '중간' THEN 3 WHEN '낮음' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT domain, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN effectiveness = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1 ) AS effectiveness_rate, COUNT(*) AS total FROM itgc_control GROUP BY domain ORDER BY domain

SELECT ep.eval_quarter AS quarter, COUNT(ep.id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS effective, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '부분효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial, SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '비효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ineffective, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN er.conclusion = '효과적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(ep.id), 0) * 100, 1 ) AS effectiveness_rate FROM itgc_eval_plan ep LEFT JOIN itgc_eval_result er ON er.eval_plan_id = ep.id WHERE ep.eval_year = #{year} GROUP BY ep.eval_quarter ORDER BY ep.eval_quarter
SELECT f.id, f.finding_no, f.title, f.severity, f.status, f.dept, f.owner, f.due_date, f.discovery_date, f.remediation_progress FROM itgc_finding f ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cc.component, cc.component_name, cc.weight, COALESCE( ROUND( (SELECT AVG( CASE er.conclusion WHEN '효과적' THEN 100 WHEN '부분효과적' THEN 60 WHEN '비효과적' THEN 20 ELSE NULL END ) FROM itgc_eval_plan ep JOIN itgc_control c ON c.id = ep.control_id LEFT JOIN itgc_eval_result er ON er.eval_plan_id = ep.id WHERE ep.eval_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) ), 1 ), 0 ) AS score FROM itgc_coso_config cc ORDER BY cc.component

SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS count, MIN(due_date) AS earliest_due, MAX(due_date) AS latest_due FROM itgc_finding WHERE status IN ('미결','조치중') AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN '심각' THEN 1 WHEN '높음' THEN 2 WHEN '중간' THEN 3 WHEN '낮음' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
